description: SQL Server is Microsoft's table database. Its SQL form is called T-SQL. Learn named values, small tables and queries, then meet safe conversions, numbered results and transactions using sample records. Use SQL Server 2019+ in a separate practice database with a SQL editor. T-SQL is different from the SQLite engine on this site, so these examples are for that separate tool.
versionNote: Uses SQL Server 2019+ T-SQL, table variables and core query features.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change the variable to another sample name
Learn to change the minimum page count to 70
Learn to reverse the page order and predict the numbers
learningObjectives: Learn to change the variable to another sample name
